title: comparisonPanes
responsibility: Pairs revision content with its own commit, label, role and explicit evidence gap.

inputs.name: comparisonPanes.before
inputs.description: Contains the parent-side value and metadata used only when paired is true; null is replaced with an empty side before building the pane. The side is not read when paired is false.

examples.gap: Parent revision has no additional evidence notes.

inputs.name: comparisonPanes.after
inputs.description: Contains the after-side value and metadata used in both paired and current comparisons. A missing commit becomes an empty string, an undefined value gets the default evidence gap unless gap is supplied, and currentLabel/currentRole affect only unpaired output.

examples.gap: One check has no attached output.

inputs.name: comparisonPanes.paired
inputs.description: Selects two panes or one current pane. The source default is true, so only false selects the unpaired form.

outputs.name: comparisonPanes
outputs.description: Returns two panes in before/after order when paired is true, or one after pane with phase current when false. Each pane's fields are copied or derived from that side; a missing commit becomes empty, labels and roles use paired/current defaults, and an undefined value gets the default gap unless gap is supplied.

errors.name: Side access error
errors.description: If reading a side property invokes a getter that throws, the exception propagates while the pane is built. The helper does not catch or wrap it.
